citation: Moro S, Rita P, Cortez P (2014), Bank Marketing, UCI
features: All predictors except duration (last-call duration); unknown treated as explicit category
cleaning: Retain all raw rows; feature-identical groups cannot cross train/certification partitions
split: GroupShuffleSplit test_size=.5; 50% groups training, 50% certification; no predictive test evaluation
subsets: Nested random row prefixes of full certification set; seed+100; no stratification or reselection
models: LR C=1 max_iter=2000; RF120 minleaf5 max_features=sqrt n_jobs2; train-only imputation, LR scaling, onehot categorical
timing: First call and two additional timed calls; median plus all samples; includes solver preparation, excludes training and verification; not baseline speedup
limitations: One dataset; nested sizes and repeated models dependent; random feature groups not verified clients or temporal validity; no predictive accuracy claim
